features.title: Writing & revision
features.description: Write in Markdown, format text, check spelling, and undo or redo each version separately, even after restarting.

features.title: Drafts
features.description: Every draft is its own file on your Mac with all its versions and media. Titles come from the first sentence, or your AI once there is enough text. Export any draft as a folder.

features.title: Inbox & progress
features.description: See every draft with when you last edited it, how many versions it has, and whether it is an idea, drafting, ready, or live. Press ⌘N for a new draft.

features.title: Images for social
features.description: Paste images into a draft as they are, then click one to crop it for Instagram, TikTok, or YouTube and copy it back. Images are stored inside the draft.

features.title: Make Draft yours
features.description: Create your own features, keep them through official updates, and undo an update any time.

features.title: Sync with Zo
features.description: Sync drafts with Zo after writing, check a small shared index on app activity, and reduce background checks while idle. Concurrent writing, offline edits and recoverable deletes are preserved.
